records.finding: Package doc claimed metric tags AND log ddtags carry only ADR-0004 bounded dimensions, but only metric tags are emitter-fenced; log ddtags read raw flow/stage off the outcome event, so an unregistered/dynamic flow mints a new tag value.
records.evidence: doc: 'Metric tags and log ddtags carry only the ADR-0004 bounded dimensions'; logTags builds ddtags from vals := {"flow": o.VC.Flow, "stage": o.Stage, ...}
records.reason: Rewrote the package doc and ExportEvents comment to state the asymmetry (metric tags bounded via emitter fence; log ddtag keys fixed and outcome a bounded enum, but flow/stage values raw — keep flow/stage namespaces bounded). Mirrors the Loki adapter's honest caveat; ADR-0004's guarantee is scoped to metrics.

records.finding: maxBatch=500 chunking in ExportMetrics and ExportEvents was untested — all batches stayed under 500, so the boundary math (multiple posts, tail slice) was unverified.
records.evidence: const maxBatch = 500; for start := 0; start < len(items); start += maxBatch { end := start + maxBatch; if end > len(items) { end = len(items) } ... }
records.reason: Added TestChunkingAtMaxBatch (table-driven: 500 -> 1 post, 501 -> 2, 1007 -> 3) for BOTH the series and logs paths, asserting post counts and that the item total is preserved (no loss or duplication).
